descriptions.w3d_d26e_doppler_factor_801e560c: Doppler factor of a 3D sound: listener velocity and position (listener virtual slot 17, kinds 4 and 3), emitter position and velocity, direction normalized, speeds along it scaled by emitter slot 11, emitter slot 13 scales (1 - v_e) / (1 + v_l), minus 1, clamped to [-1, 1]. Reading of the physics is inferred from the arithmetic; virtual slot names are unknown.
